verdict.rationale: React's entire interaction model is code-driven through an extensively documented public API (createRoot, hydrateRoot, JSX, hooks, 'use client', component composition, etc.), which any programmatic actor including an AI coding agent can call to build and manipulate UIs. However, missing for 10: explicit agent-orchestration guidance, service/runtime API endpoints for live automation, and independent hands-on evidence of AI agents driving React specifically via this API.
